summary: The entry documents lead a new reader into a small, inspectable task and supply the necessary operation and mathematics warm-ups. Chapter1 separates character IDs, data splits, shifted questions, probabilities, loss, gradients, updates and generation. Its observed color/shape failure from seeing only the preceding equals sign gives chapter2 a concrete reason to extend context. Chapter2 then distinguishes having a useful clue from actually learning it, and its held-out window comparison avoids promising that a longer window is always better. Chapter3 builds content-dependent reading from the same weighted-sum and softmax tools before introducing Q/K/V, scale, causal access and heads. Chapter4 reuses those concepts to preserve positions, add residual corrections, normalize each position, construct blocks and produce correctly aligned next-unit scores. The following introduction and complete5.1 add the optimizer update to the gradients chapter4 computed, with an explicit fixed-example diagnostic rather than an inflated language-quality claim. All11 assigned files were fully read, and all13 referenced current teaching SVGs were personally rendered and viewed. I found no continuity issue in this scope. All assigned document bytes and viewed SVG bytes match source25ca4bf5f8f8dc0a9e88aa6cd70caeb4c2f419e8 despite the later evidence-only Git HEAD. The reading receipt records actual completion order, interleaved partial reads, boundary scope and limitations; this is not this reviewer’s verdict on the entire book.

prerequisites.details: R.1 and1.1 offer W.2 before unfamiliar Python notation; W.1 teaches installation, cells, kernels and restart order. W.3 explains axes, reductions and reshaping before1.5 and later[B,T,D] shapes. W.4 introduces probability, exponent/log intuition and the correct cross-entropy input before1.7–1.8. W.5 supplies weighted sums, matrix multiplication, Linear weight layout and transpose before2.3. W.6 and1.9–1.13 prepare differentiation, multiple paths, update direction and clearing gradients. Chapter3 starts with hand-specified mixtures before learned projections;3.5 derives the independent variance assumption before4.3 uses LayerNorm. Chapter4 introduces every block component before assembly, and5.1 explicitly treats AdamW as a supplied update tool with details deferred to named later sections. The concrete calculations and linked warm-ups are sufficient for the stated high-school/basic-college mathematics reader; no unprovided prerequisite blocked the assigned consecutive route.

terminology.details: ID remains a lookup convention rather than a semantic magnitude. The change from Embedding outputting V candidate logits in1.6 to D intermediate features in2.1 is explicitly explained as the same lookup operation with a different use. Each example states its own local vocabulary and dimensions; B/C/D, Tq/Tk/Dk and per-head shapes retain named roles.3.1 distinguishes nonnegative normalized reading weights from unconstrained Linear parameter weights.3.7 separates head count, positions, feature width, cached K/V and the attention ratio table.4.6 explicitly distinguishes the language-model output head from attention heads.1.15 names generation temperature locally, while3.5 separates it from fixed attention scaling. Shift aligns answers; causal mask restricts access; masked_loss may omit targets and does not shift again. Residual information flow and reverse sensitivity are consistently described as different directions. The complete glossary makes the same distinctions and identifies later tokenization, padding and loss-mask topics without requiring their premature mastery.

examples_and_exercises.details: The exercises change specified inputs or parameters and provide predictions a reader can check from prior explanations. Examples consistently identify hand-set numbers, random initializations and actually trained results. The1.10 multiplier exercise updates both the forward multiplier and displayed local derivative;1.12 deliberately uses a failing large step;1.13 explains why an assertion concerning the first two gradients does not test the third.2.4 uses the same weights with and without ReLU to make the new operation identifiable.2.5 separates toy identifiability questions from the actual MLP experiment and reports the parameter-count change and one-document validation limit.3.6 changes a future value to test permitted access and makes the no-mask failure intentional.4.6–4.7 show how position/candidate axes become cross-entropy questions and why lengths alone cannot catch copy-the-input targets.4.8 decomposes parameter counts and distinguishes its untrained width8 models from the separate trained width64 byte-vocabulary model. All13 viewed figures agree with the neighboring numbers, axis roles and exercises. No new computation was needed to understand these transitions, so none of the teaching kernels were rerun.

source_runtime_scope.details: The entry pages, environment guide and asset-storage guide distinguish ordinary source files, fixed data snapshots, inference exports and full continuation state; they distinguish the small-model .venv from chapter20’s .venv-natural and its separate packages. They also separate displayed CPU examples, formal L4 training, an observed CPU run, limited MPS checks and unverified Colab execution. In the chapter path, backward computes gradients and does not update parameters; hand-specified generation does not train; successful shape checks do not establish semantic ability. Train/validation/test meanings introduced in1.2 survive the2.5 and4.7–4.8 transitions. The Chinese character examples, separate English short-text byte model with264 candidates and the late natural-data assistant are explicitly bounded to their respective settings. I observed the current preview’s1.1 CPU output and pinned notebook target, without claiming to have rerun it. Numerical experimental claims and later chapters were not re-audited against original reports in this continuity task; those reports and previous reviews were not read.

navigation_and_path.details: Actual Chromium clicks root→reading guide→1.1→W.2 and root→warm-up→1.1 reached the expected pages. W.1 and W.2 anchors place visible warm-up headings beneath the fixed header. The1.1 page displays the same character IDs and restored sentence explained in the source and shows Colab/download actions with a nearby operation link; its Colab destination pins source25ca4bf5 and notebooks/01/1.1.ipynb. The chapter01–05 introductions and first-lesson routes match the sequential motivations read in the source.4.7’s T.4 link reaches training.html#T.4 under 把文字訓練和對話練習分開看; its opening text and9/1/2 toy-text split table are relevant to the promised text training. training.html#T.8 reaches 架構比較一次只換一個條件, also present in the table of contents; its rendered body actually contains architecture and efficiency comparisons with stated prerequisites and scope limits. Numeric labels are absent from those visible headings, but working anchors, topic headings and relevant bodies let a reader find the intended content. This assessment covers the representative navigation needed for this path, not every external link or the separate final full-site audit. Reading-time estimates were unfinished and excluded.
